description: The Speedwing Sparrow is a swift and agile bird known for its incredible speed in flight. Its feathers shimmer with hues of silver and blue, making it a breathtaking sight as it darts through forests and open skies. It is often seen as a symbol of freedom and swiftness by those who admire nature's wonders.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.description: If the Speedwing Sparrow is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

traits.name: Keen Sight
traits.description: The Speedwing Sparrow has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Talons
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Dive Attack
actions.description: If the Speedwing Sparrow is flying and dives at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a talon attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) slashing damage.
